basic_profile.bio: A 30-something condo-dweller living in the Pacific Northwest. Passionate about DIY home improvement and learning the ropes of plumbing, though I'm more of an amateur. Outside of home projects, I'm a full-time software developer and I spend my weekends hiking. I'm currently single and spend my evenings between 8-10 PM diving into Reddit threads about economics, home improvement, and sometimes just for a good laugh.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mostly self-taught through online resources and trial and error. I hold a degree in Computer Science but have no formal education in plumbing or home improvement. My interest in these areas grew after purchasing my condo and facing various maintenance challenges.
